text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final crown of the Triple Tiara route, 
the Shuka Sho. The reporters' attention is 
fixed upon two Umamusume: Daiwa Scarlet 
and Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having switched to sprint races, it was 
natural for Aston Machan to fade from 
view. But today, she psyched herself up to 
make everyone remember she was here!
